Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this game and also from the ODI series. India have sealed a 3-0 win over the Windies. The focus now shifts to Kolkata for the T20I series. The first match of the three-match series between these two sides begins on Wednesday, the 16th of February at the Eden Gardens. The match begins at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT) but our coverage as always will begin a lot sooner. Do join us then. Goodbye and take care!
Rohit Sharma goes ahead and lifts the trophy for winning the series and the Indian side is then seen posing with the trophy for the winning moment photograph.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma says that it is important to get the job done and they have ticked a lot of boxes in this series. He adds that the noise will be around as long as they are playing and they are playing a high-profile game in India. He mentions that outside noise does not matter much and it is about executing skills in the middle. He applauds Krishna for his potential of hitting the deck and says he is a good prospect for India. He adds on and says that all the bowlers bowled well. He says that Kuldeep and Chahal are both important players for India and especially Kuldeep went off the radar a little and it is good to get him back. He states that it will take time and it is important to give them game-time. He says that the biggest takeaway for them was the middle-order batting and the top order did not do much but it is good to see middle-order doing well and bailing the team out of the trouble and again mentions it as the biggest takeaway from the series according to him.

Prasidh Krishna is named as the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for picking up 9 wickets over the course of 3 matches. He says that now that he has played a lot more domestic games, his bowling has a good rhythm about it. He says that anything getting a good carry through to the keeper regularly is a good sign for him and every fast bowler wants to pick up wickets regularly and is happy he could do that tonight as well. He mentions that they have top bowling talents in their squad and it takes a team effort to win matches. He also mentions that he tries to stay grounded and just keep on putting in the hard work.

Shreyas Iyer is adjudged the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his knock of 80 runs! He says that life was tough for him in the last couple of months with food poisoning, injuries and Covid as well. He says that he is flexible to bat at any position but he likes batting at number 4. He says that it is about building the innings first up and then carrying on from there. He mentions that he thrives on pressure situations like today.

West Indies skipper, Nicholas Pooran says that it was a wonderful opportunity today and wants to congratulate India on the win and also Rohit Sharma on winning his first white-ball series as full-time captain. He adds that India were brilliant with the ball tonight as well as throughout the series and hopes that the batters can make amends. He adds that they are now looking forward to the T20I series and hopes that they can perform better.
Time for the Presentation ceremony...

Deepak Chahar is up for a chat. Deepak says that he thinks about bowling to his plans and tries to do well every time he plays. He says that he wanted to target the spinners when he was batting but would have loved to carry on. He mentions that his plan B is to change the pace of the ball when it is not swinging and variations are key. He adds that his plan B depends on the conditions and situation in the middle.

Mohammed Siraj is down for a quick chat. He says that there was a little bit of swing and that was the plan to swing the ball bowling on a length. Siraj says that dropping a catch or taking a good catch is part and parcel of the game and he tried to focus on his own bowling and bowl back of a length to Smith. He adds that scrambled seam is his wicket-taking ball and that's why he looks to make the most of that delivery.

The top-order problems for West Indies continue to cost them matches they could have won. This has now become a regular feature of their ODI set up and in the longer form of white-ball cricket, the openers play the most vital role. Hope and King fell cheaply and Brooks soon followed. Darren Bravo looked edgy but managed to hold the fort for a bit. Nicholas Pooran, the skipper looked positive but once Bravo got out, Holder and Pooran too followed. With over 150 runs required, Odean Smith played freely and hit 36 runs off just 18 balls before being dismissed. Alzarri Joseph along with Hayden Walsh put on a 47-run partnership for the ninth wicket. This only proves that the Windies do have enough batting depth to get them over the line in close matches but when the top-order fails as miserably as it has done in the series, the tail-enders need to be applauded for their effort. West Indies will now look to turn their focus onto the T20I series and hope to get a win on this tour.

Deepak Chahar is a highly-rated new ball bowler and he showed today exactly why. He picked up two wickets early on and his new-ball partner, Mohammed Siraj too got a wicket. This pinged the opposition firmly on the back foot and after that, the wickets just kept on coming. Krishna and Kuldeep bowled well after the Powerplay and picked up wickets at regular intervals. Kuldeep was hammered a bit by Odean Smith but he will be happy with his comeback overall. The ninth wicket partnership troubled India for a while and the fielding got a bit sloppy as well with a few misfields and a couple of easy dropped catches. But Siraj broke the partnership and Krishna finished things off as both of them ended with 3 wickets each. Overall, a really strong showing with the ball yet again from India.

India have completed the whitewash and they hardly broke a sweat strolling through this match. The batters put on a decent total but the bowlers broke the back of the Windies chase pretty early on to hand them a thumping defeat. The visitors will be thoroughly disappointed with their batting effort, not just tonight but on the whole as well. It's also the first time ever India have beaten West Indies 3-0 in a three-match series.

OUT! CAUGHT! It's all over! India clinch the series 3-0! Another dominating bowling performance by India. Prasidh Krishna stays with the ploy of bowling it short. He bangs it short on middle with good pace. Alzarri Joseph looks to pull but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes in the air towards deep square leg and Virat Kohli settles under it to take a comfortable catch. Good fight shown by Alzarri Joseph but the defeat was inevitable after the top-order failed miserably yet again. Prasidh Krishna gets his third wicket and India win by 96 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker this time on middle after pushing him back on the previous deliveries. Roach blocks it out.
Over the wicket this time. A length ball, on middle. Roach works it to leg slip.
On a length, on middle. Roach blocks it out.

Indian players appeal there but the umpire is not interested! Shorter length delivery around leg from 'round the wicket. Roach looks to pull but misses. The ball goes close to the bat and Indian players try their luck with the appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Kemar Roach is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper Rohit Sharma takes the catch and throws the ball in disgust! It's just a bit of frustration that it has taken his side this long to break this stand. A good short ball, on leg. Hayden Walsh gets cramped for room yet again as he looks to fend it away. In the end, the ball pops up off the gloves and goes to the right of leg slip. Rohit Sharma takes a couple of steps and pouches it comfortably. Walsh falls after offering good resistance and it's just a matter of time now. Mohammed Siraj has his third wicket and India just one wicket away from a clean sweep.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Siraj hits the length hard and bowls it around leg. Walsh looks to make a bit of room for himself but gets cramped for room.
Mohammed Siraj to continue. He is into his 9th over now.

TWO LEG BYES! Nicely flighted, on a length and on off. The ball turns in and Joseph presses forward to defend. The ball clips the pad and pops up over the fielder at leg slip. The batters come back for two leg byes.
Going down leg, Joseph gets it off the pads towards short leg.
Flatter one, sliding into middle. Joseph tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Flighted, around off. Joseph prods to defend.

SIX! Lovely flow of the bat and Alzarri Joseph keeps on frustrating the Indian bowlers. Tossed up, on off. Joseph hits through the line and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie. West Indies need less than 100 now. Is a miracle on the cards?
On a length, turning in from outside off. Joseph keeps it out.
WIDE! Quicker one, spilled way down the leg side. Wided.
Back of a length yet again, on off. Walsh hops and keeps it out on the off side.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Walsh defends it off the back foot.

Dropped! That's the second drop catch off Siraj's bowling and he doesn't look impressed. A well-directed short ball, on middle. Alzarri Joseph pulls this one high and towards the backward square leg fence. Prasidh Krishna over there settles under it but ends up making a meal of it. Single taken.
On the pads, tucked away to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, over middle. Joseph gets behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Short of a length, from 'round the wicket and at the body. Joseph looks to pull it behind square but misses.
Flatter this time, on middle. Walsh with another defensive block.
Tossed up, on middle. Walsh pushes it towards cover.
Drifted into off. Walsh blocks it out.

TWO WIDES! Turning down the leg side, Rishabh Pant spills it and the batters also cross cover. Pant can be heard on the stump mic mentioning that he knowingly spilled it to get the left-hander back on strike. Just having some fun out there Pant.
Turning in from off and Joseph does well to keep it out.
Shorter in length, turning in from outside off. Joseph hops onto the back foot and pushes it towards the bowler.
A flighted delivery, around off. Joseph strides out to defend.
Back of a length, on leg. Walsh hops to defend.
And again! Around the top of off and Hayden Walsh just lets it through to the keeper.
Length again, close to the off pole. Walsh with a good leave.
Length again, on middle. Joseph shuffles and gets inside the line of the ball to tuck it towards fine leg for a run.
A length ball, angled into middle and leg. Joseph pushes it towards silly mid on.
A short ball, on off. Joseph ducks under it.
Mohammed Siraj (6-0-27-2) is back on.
Another misfield! Shorter in length, on middle. Alzarri Joseph pulls it to fine leg and Siraj there fumbles a little and a single is taken.

FOUR! Alzarri Joseph adds some more runs to his kitty. A shorter length delivery on middle. Alzarri Joseph looks to pull it but fails to get enough blade.The ball runs towards fine leg and there are many players coneverging to stop it but the ball runs away to the fence.

A slight misfield produces a chance of run out but no damage done. A fuller delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph drives it to mid off. The fielder there misfields and Alzarri Joseph looks for a single but is sent back as there is throw at the batter's end. Alzarri Joseph is safe.
A  length delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph dabs it to point.
Back of a length, around off. Walsh dabs it to backward point for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Walsh drives it to mid off now.
Fuller and a easy single taken now towards deep square leg. A flick off the pads this.
Just misses the outside edge this time! A tossed up delivery around off. Walsh looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
A fuller delivery on middle. Alzarri Joseph works it to deep square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.

An optimistic appeal this time but the umpire is not interested. Slower through the air, on middle and turning into the batter. Alzarri Joseph looks to defend but the ball hits his pads. There is an appeal but going down leg.
Tossed up on off. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Fuller on middle. Alzarri Joseph works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, around leg. Slower in pace. Walsh looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits his thigh and a leg bye is taken towards short third man.
A short ball by Deepak Chahar on middle. Walsh ducks under it. These two are frustrating India here.
WIDE! A slower delivery and down the leg side this time. Walsh lets it go.
Chahar goes fuller now on off. Walsh drives it crisply to mid off.
On a length, on off. Walsh blocks it out.
Deepak Chahar (6-1-32-2) is back into the attack.
Chahar starts with a shorter length delivery on off. Joseph looks to pull but gets the inside edge onto his shoulder. The ball goes towards third man for a single.
He bowls it fuller this time on off. Walsh is solid in his front foot defence.
Slightly shorter on middle. Alzarri Joseph works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Pant is telling Sundar to bowl little full.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Flatter on middle. Walsh works it to square leg for a single.
Shorter in length around middle. Walsh pushes at this off the back foot little aerially towards mid on.
FOUR! Sundar is greeted with a boundary here! A half-tracker on off. Walsh goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Washington Sundar is brought into the attack for the first time tonight.
Single to end the over. On a length, around off. Walsh steers it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off at 135.6 kph. Walsh leaves it alone.
On a length, on off. Walsh is right behind it and blocks it.
A good-length delivery, around off. Walsh leaves it alone this time.
Prasidh Krishna bangs this short on off. Walsh sways away from the line of the ball.
A full delivery and wider outside off. Alzarri Joseph drives but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
A loopy delivery on off. Walsh leans forward and blocks it.
Slighty shorter on off. Walsh goes back and blocks it.
On middle and turning into the batter. Alzarri Joseph works it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up nicely outside off. Walsh looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge this time. A single taken towards backward point.
Misfield by Suryakumar Yadav allows a couple now. A fuller delivery on off. Walsh drives it to covers. Yadav misfields and a couple of runs are taken.
A fuller delivery on off. Walsh drives it back to the bowler.
SIX! Top edge and goes over the fence! A good short delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph pulls it and gets a top edge this time. The ball sails over fine leg for a maximum.
Slightly fuller on middle. Alzarri Joseph clips it to mid-wicket.
A good-length deliver, outside off. Alzarri Joseph lets it go.
On a length, on off. Alzarri Joseph blocks it this time.

An overthrow allows a single. Needless throw by Siraj! A fuller delivery, on off. Walsh drives it to mid off. Siraj there collects it and fires in  a throw at the batter's end. The batter is well inside his crease and a single is taken after that.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Walsh leaves it alone.
Another loopy delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph defends it off the back foot.
On middle and fuller. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Another one that is turning into the batter. On middle and leg. Joseph gets the inside edge of his blade onto his pads.
A fuller delivery on off. Walsh drives it back to the bowler. Yadav half-stops it and a single is taken.
Slightly shorter on off. Alzarri Joseph works it to deep square leg for a single.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Alzarri Joseph defends it off the inner half of his blade to the leg side.
Length again, angled across the left-hander. Walsh steers it towards backward point.
WIDE! Siraj digs it in short, over middle and the ball flies over the batter's head. Wided.
Around the top of off. Walsh keeps it out.
Back of a length, angling across off. Walsh defends it out.
Hayden Walsh is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammed Siraj sticks to the hard length and does get his man in the end! On a good length, around off. Odean Smith hangs deep in his crease and looks to go over mid off. There is a bit of zip through off the surface and a bit of extra bounce as well. The ball goes off the splice of the bat and pops up towards covers. Shikhar Dhawan over there takes a reverse-cup catch and he too almost spills it. End of an entertaining cameo from Odean Smith.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: A spicy short ball, over middle. Smith charges down the track and looks to pull but misses.

FOUR! Odean Smith is just going hard at everything and is reaping rewards. A good length ball, on off. Smith looks to go big downtown but gets a thick outside edge which flies down to the third man fence for a boundary.

Beaten! Kuldeep tosses it up nicely, outside off. Alzarri Joseph presses forward to get to the pitch of the ball but the ball turns back in a long way and goes between bat and pad. Luckily for Joseph the ball doesn't hit the stumps.
On the shorter side and on middle. Joseph gets behind the line of the ball to block.
WIDE! On the pads and turning down leg. Joseph misses the flick and a wide is called.
On off, Joseph blocks it out.
On off, Smith presses forward and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Nicely bowled! Loopy ball, very full and wide. Smith can't reach it this time.

SIX! Now that is a serious, serious hit from Odean Smith! Tossed up, on off and turning in. Smith clears the front leg and sends it into orbit. The ball finally lands deep in the stands over the long on fence. He'll just get six runs for it though.
Back of a length, on off. Smith hops back and dabs it onto the leg side for a quick single. Good running.
A length ball, around the top of off. Smith blocks it out.
Shorter in length, Joseph pulls it behind square for a single.

Dropped! Suryakumar Yadav has spilled an absolute sitter! Cross-seamed delivery, on a hard length, on off. Odean Smith looks to lift this one over the long on fence but gets a top edge towards the extra cover region. SKY is a bit too eager as he celebrates even before pouching the catch and end sup spilling it. Single taken.
No timing on that. Good-length, around off. Smith looks to thump it down the ground but mistimes it towards mid off.
WIDE! Short ball, over off. A bit too short and a wide is called.
Banged in short, over middle. Smith pulls it well in front of square and picks up a couple.
Flighted this time, around off and turning in. Joseph keeps it out.
On a length, around off and slower through the air. Joseph keeps it out on the off stump.
Full, on off. Smith doesn't quite get underneath the delivery and only manages to drill it down to long off for a single.
WIDE! Shorter one, spilled down the leg side. Wided.
SIX! Geez, that's just raw power! Tossed up, fuller and on off. Odean Smith clears the front leg and powers it over the long off fence for another biggie.
SIX! Odean Smith wants to go down fighting. Another googly, outside off. Smith fetches it and clubs it flat and over the long on fence for a maximum.
Tossed up, on a length, around off and turning away. Smith gets a bit taken aback by that one.
Prasidh Krishna pulls his length back this time and bowls this outside off. Alzarri Joseph leaves it alone. End of a maiden over from Krishna.
Goes fuller now on middle. Alzarri Joseph drives it to mid on.
A length delivery on middle. Alzarri Joseph clips it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and wider outside off. Alzarri Joseph looks to cut but gets beaten.
On middle again and fuller. Alzarri Joseph clips it to mid-wicket.
Krishna bowls this fuller on middle. Alzarri Joseph defends it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Another boundary for Odean Smith! Slightly shorter around off. Smith waits for it and slams it through covers for a boundary.
On middle. Smith blocks it out.
FOUR! A tough chance this for Kuldeep Yadav. Fuller on middle. Smith smashes it hard back to the bowler and before Yadav could react it goes towards the fence for a boundary.
Odean Smith is in at number 9.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kuldeep Yadav is back for India and he is doing what he did when he first came onto the scene. Yadav tosses this up nicely outside off. Pooran thinks that it is a ball to drive and he goes for it. The ball turns away sharply and takes the outside edge of his blade. Rohit Sharma takes another catch at first slip and West Indies skipper, Nicholas Pooran walks back disappointed.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Kuldeep Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and leg this time. Alzarri Joseph works it to deep square leg for a single this time.
On off and turning into the batter. Alzarri Joseph works it towards the leg side.
Another delivery on that length and around off. Pooran dabs it to backward point again.
On a length, outside off. Pooran steers it towards backward point.
On a length, on off. Pooran blocks it out this time.
Shorterb length delivery on off. Pooran tries to pull it but mistimes it towards the leg side just away from the turf.
Back of a length, around off. Pooran dabs it to point now.
A fuller delivery on middle. Pooran flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Another one that beats the blade of the batter! Slower in the air, around off and turning away. Alzarri Joseph goes back and looks to defend but gets beaten off the outside edge.
Shorter on off. Pooran pulls it to long on for a single.
This is drifted in from around off. Nicholas Pooran gets low looking to sweep but the ball turns away sharply and Pooran is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on off. Alzarri Joseph drives it to long off for a single.
Alzarri Joseph comes in with West Indies in serious trouble.

Huge appeal from Rishabh Pant which almost looked like a stumping appeal but the umpire has given Fabian Allen caught behind. Allen has reviewed it and now the catch and stumping both will be checked. UltraEdge shows that there is a huge spike, so no need to check the stumping and maybe it was just a hopeful review. The on-field decision of OUT stays and Allen has to walk back.

OUT!CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust! Kuldeep Yadav gets his first wicket in his comeback game. Kuldeep Yadav tosses this up nicely around off. The ball turns away and catches the outside edge of Allen's blade who tries to drive it. Rishabh Pant takes the catch but Fabian Allen is not sure whether he has nicked it or not and goes for a review. The replays rolll in and the UltraEdge shows that bat is involved there. So Fabian Allen has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Kuldeep Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off. Pooran drives it to long off for a single.
Fabian Allen walks out to bat at number 7.

OUT! CAUGHT! Prasidh Krishna gets his second wicket and Jason Holder departs now. West Indies are in all sort of trouble. A length delivery in that channel around off. Upright seam position by Prasidh Krishna. Holder pushes at it with hard hands and gets the outside edge of his blade. The ball goes towards Rohit Sharma at first slip and he takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...but safe! On a length, on middle. The ball holds in the surface a little, Holder looks to work it towards the leg side but is early on the shot. A leading edge takes it over the bowler.
Ohh..nice carry this time! Back of a length, outside off. Holder is surprised by the bounce and lets it go.
On a length, on middle. Holder clips it to mid-wicket now.
FOUR! Short ball and punished! Krishna bangs this short on off. Holder stays deep in his crease and pulls it comfortably towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller on middle. Pooran flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle and slower this time. Holder puts a big stride forward and defends it.
Flatter and outside off. Holder gets back to defend but is beaten again.
Tossed up on middle this time. Holder pushes forward to defend but the ball turns away sharply and hits his back leg. There is a mild appeal but it is going down leg.
Tossed up, outside off at 78.2 kph. Pooran drives it crisply to sweeper cover for a single.
On off and turning away a little this time. Holder defends it with soft hands and gets it to backward  point for a single.
Nicely tossed up on off. Holder drives it back to the bowler.
Prasidh Krishna hits the bat hard again. On a length, on off. Pooran solidly blocks it.
Beaten! A length delivery, angling across Pooran. He tries to push at it but get beaten off the outside edge.
Back of a length, around off. Pooran dabs it to point this time.
Pitched up on off. Holder drives it left of mid off for a single.
On a length, on middle. Holder drives it to mid on.

DRINKS! It has been a brilliant start for India as Mohammed Siraj and especially Deepak Chahar have done a spectacular job in the first Powerplay by picking up 3 wickets. Top-order woes for the Windies continue as no one really looks to be wanting to spend time at the crease. Bravo and Pooran did put on a nice little partnership but now that Bravo has departed, the skipper Nicholas Pooran has too much to do on his own. He needs someone to stay with him as he looks to give his side a chance in this match. India seem to be cruising and are set up nicely for a whitewash. Jason Holder walks in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Darren Bravo is gone this time and his resistance comes to an end. Prasidh Krishna is among the wickets again. Prasidh Krishna serves this on a good length, outside off. Bravo goes for the cover drive but it's a loose shot and the outside edge is found. The ball goes to Virat Kohli at second slip and he is not going to drop those. West Indies lose their fourth and are in trouble with the bat yet again. Full marks to Rohit Sharma for keeping a second slip in the 14th over.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Shorter and around leg. Bravo looks to clip it first then tries to leave it. There is a sound there as the ball goes back to the keeper. Sharma thinks of taking a review but decides against it.
Some turn there! Yadav tosses this up nicely around off. Pooran looks to drive it but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
SIX! Pooran is getting into his groove now! Shorter length delivery on off. Pooran rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
On middle this time. Pooran flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Slightly on the shorter side again, around off. Bravo punches it to covers for a single.
Shorter and turning away. Bravo pushes it to point.
Almost a wicket off the first ball! A flatter delivery on off. Bravo looks to push at it but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Kuldeep Yadav is now brought into the attack.
On a length, on off. Pooran solidly blocks it.
A length delivery on off. Pooran defends it back to the bowler.

Find the edge this time but the ball falls short of Kohli at second slip. Back of a length, around off. Pooran pushes at it and gets the outside edge of his blade and short of diving Kohli. He played with soft hands there.
Ohh..lovely delivery! A good-length delivery around off. Pooran looks to defend it but the ball seams away a little and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Slightly fuller this time. Pooran clips it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Back of a length, on middle. Bravo looks to tuck it away towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits his thigh and a leg bye is taken towards backward square leg.
In the air...but safe! A length delivery, outside off. Bravo slashes his bat hard at that one and gets it to deep cover for a single.

Big news from the upcoming T20I series between India and West Indies - KL Rahul and Axar Patel have both been ruled out of the upcoming series. Rahul is ruled out due to an active left hamstring issue and Axar Patel is still in the recovery process after testing positive for Covid-19. Ruturaj Gaikwad and Deepak Hooda have been added to the side in place of Rahul and Axar Patel.
Another shorter length delivery on off. Pooran pulls it to deep square leg this time for just a single.
FOUR! That's a fine shot from a fine player! Shorterb length delivery around off. Pooran stays back and pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
Back of a length this time and slower in pace. Bravo waits for it and works it to square leg for a single.
Chahar serves this on a length, outside  off. Bravo goes for a big booming drive but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length, outside off. Pooran cuts it hard to deep cover for a single.
End of Powerplay 1. Now, 4 fielders can stay outside the ring till the 40th over in Powerplay 2.
Peach of a delivery to end the over. A good length ball, on off. The ball angles away a bit and just zips past the outside edge. At the end of the first Powerplay, West Indies are 47/3!
On off. Blocked out by Bravo.
On a good length, around leg and angling in. Pooran works it towards square leg for a single.
Around the top of off. Pooran defends it on the off side.

A bit of hesitation in the middle from the batter but they do get two in the end. Back of a length, around the hips. Pooran hops and tucks it past Washington Sundar at square leg. Sundar gives chase and fumbles the ball, allowing the additional run.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Pitched up, on middle. Nicholas Pooran drives it back past the bowler and the ball goes dead straight into the fence.
Prasidh Krishna is into the attack now. He replaces Mohammed Siraj.
Maiden over from Deepak Chahar! A touch short and wide, Bravo taps it straight to the point fielder.
Another short ball, over leg this time. Bravo ducks under it.
Back to over the wicket now. A well-directed short ball, around middle. Darren Bravo doesn't look comfortable with the short ball but just about manages to fend it off.
Chahar comes from 'round the wicket now and delivers a full and wide one. Bravo looks for the drive but mistimes it towards mid off.
A length ball, angling across the left-hander. Bravo strokes it towards cover.
Back of a length, on middle. Bravo looks to pull but then decides to tap it onto the off side.
Fullish delivery, on off. Pooran defends it out.
On middle and sliding across. Pooran looks to cover drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat. The ball goes nowhere.
Banged in short, around middle and leg. Pooran once again has both feet in the air as he pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length, on middle. Pooran hangs back to defend.
On middle. Pooran defends it off the front foot towards mid off.
Full, around off. Pooran drives it towards extra cover.
A good length ball, around leg. Bravo looks to work it leg side but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
In that channel around off. Bravo lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Chahar hits the length hard, outside off. Darren Bravo stands tall and punches it past the fielder at extra cover for a boundary. Top shot that from Bravo.
Good running! Banged in short, around middle. Nicholas Pooran jumps up to pull it over the mid-wicket region. The batters push hard for three and get it with ease in the end.
Pooran misses out on that one. Short and wide, there to be hit. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and slaps it with good timing but straight to the point fielder.
Pitched up, around off. Bravo pushes it through extra cover but doesn't get much timing on it. Single taken.
Nicely driven but for no run. Full, around off. Pooran drives on the up but can't get it through cover.
Back of a length, around leg. Bravo tucks it 'round the corner for a single.
A spicy short ball, over middle. Darren Bravo ducks under it.
On off. Bravo stays solid in defense.
Length again, angling across the left-hander. Blocked out.

FOUR! The scrambled seam is bothering the batters but Bravo does pick up a lucky boundary here. This one pitches outside off and just goes sharply across the left-hander. Bravo gets an outside edge that goes wide of the second slip and runs away into the third man fence.
The skipper, Nicholas Pooran walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Very soft dismissal and Shamarh Brooks has just gifted his wicket. Full and wide, shaping away a bit. Brooks doesn't move his feet and looks to drive away from the body. In the end, he has to reach for it a bit and ends up slicing it straight to Shreyas Iyer at point. Iyer takes a comfortable catch and Deepak Chahar gets a second wicket in the over. Shamarh Brooks is out for a duck and West Indies in deep trouble early on.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Deepak Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, on off. This is pushed down to mid off.
Beaten! And again! Chahar is just bowling the perfect line and length out there. Brooks looks to have a poke but is beaten on the outside edge.
Shamarh Brooks is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Dream delivery for a fast bowler and Brandon King departs early yet again. On a length and angled into off. The ball straightens after pitching and King is caught in two minds, whether to come forward or hop onto the back foot. In the end, King does neither and just pushes at it with hard hands. The ball goes off the outside edge and Suryakumar Yadav takes a good low catch at second slip. Both the Windies openers are back in the hut and India on top of proceedings here.
Commentary.Howout: c Suryakumar Yadav b Deepak Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and swinging in. Bravo tickles it down to fine leg for a run.
Shorter in length, around off. Bravo hops and taps it straight to point.
A length ball, on off. King taps it towards cover-point. 5 runs and a wicket coming off the over.
Full, around off again and this is squeezed out on the off side for a single.
Full, on off. This is driven towards mid off.
FOUR! Full, swinging down leg. Darren Bravo tickles it fine and the ball races away into the fine leg fence.
Darren Bravo walks in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Big, big inswinger and Shai Hope is rapped in front! It's the scrambled seam delivery that has done the job for Mohammed Siraj here. He pitches it up, around off and the ball jags back in a long way after pitching. Shai Hope is rooted deep in his crease and gets caught on the crease. The ball hits him on the pads and the umpire eventually raises the finger. Hope has a conversation with his partner and then just walks off. India do have the early breakthrough. The replay shows that the ball was just going over middle and leg and maybe King should have encouraged Hope to take the review.
A good length ball, around the top of off. Hope makes a good leave.
FOUR! A bit edgy but Brandon King will take it. Short and wide this time. King throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies down to the third man fence.
FOUR! Perfectly timed! Chahar looks for the magical outswinger from around leg. The ball goes straight on and King works it through mid-wicket for a lovely boundary.
Chahar goes wide of the crease and bowls an inswinger this time. King looks to hit through the line but gets it off the inner half of the bat and towards deep backward square leg. Easy two on offer.
Full, on off. King punches it towards mid off.

Review! India have taken a review for a CAUGHT BEHIND against Brandon King! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. So the original decision stays and India lose a review. Everyone heard some noise there but nothing on the UltraEdge.

Close but not close enough! On a good length, close to off stump. The ball shapes away yet again and Brandon King just has a nibble at it. The ball seems to zip past the outside edge but the keeper seems interested. India do take the review and UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. NOT OUT is the decision and King survives.
Lovely shape! Angled into off and the ball just nips away sharply after pitching. King is beaten past the outside edge yet again.
Siraj goes fuller and outside off. Shai Hope's eyes lit up as he looks for the booming cover drive. The ball though nips back in off the surface and Hope gets beaten on the inside edge.
A length ball, outside off and shaping away. Hope leaves it alone.
A scrambled seam delivery, on a good length and around off. This one jags back in sharply and Hope gets hit on the body.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! Full and wide, Shai Hope creams it through covers for a boundary, the first of the innings.
A length ball, outside off. Hope stands tall and looks to cover drive but mistimes it towards extra cover.
Fullish delivery, outside off and shaping away. Hope shoulders arms.
Mohammed Siraj will share the new ball with Deepak Chahar.
Chahar now goes for the big inswinger and delivers a yorker at the toes. King just about gets his bat on it. 5 off the first over.
Peach! A good length ball, angled into off stump. The ball just nips away after pitching and Brandon King is comprehensively beaten past the outside edge.
Brandon King seems to have broken his bat! He has a change of bat now and is ready to resume.
A gentle half-volley, on leg. King clips it past square leg and picks up another couple.

In the air...safe! A length ball, on middle and this one shapes away too. King decides to show some aggression and looks to pump it over the bowler's head. He gets it off the toe end of the bat and luckily for King, the ball lands in between the fielders from mid off and mid on who were running back. Two taken.
A length ball, outside off and moving further away. Brandon King makes an easy leave.
A bit of shape to start with from Deepak Chahar. Pitched up, on off and shaping away. Shai Hope pushes it with the shape towards covers for a quick single. Hope and West Indies are underway.
